question: Genetics Investigation Scenario 118: A father has blood group AB (IAIB) and the mother has blood group O (ii). What blood groups can their offspring inherit?

question: Pedigree analysis problem 68: Why is embryonic stem cell research subject to greater ethical and legal debate than research utilizing adult (somatic) stem cells or induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs)?

explanation: The core ethical controversy centers on the moral status of the human embryo and its destruction during the harvesting of the inner cell mass.

question: Pedigree analysis problem 123: A man who has hemophilia (XhY) marries a woman who does not have hemophilia and has no family history of hemophilia (XHXH). What are the chances of their daughters and sons having hemophilia?
correct_answer: 0% of sons have hemophilia, and 100% of daughters are carriers (XHXh)
wrong_answers_pool: 50% of sons have hemophilia, and 50% of daughters are carriers
